actions.name: agency_hosting_list_available_datacenters
actions.description:
List available datacenters. Lists the datacenters available for provisioning a new website on the given Agency Plan
hosting order.

Each datacenter includes a `pinger_url` you can ping from the client to measure round-trip
latency; comparing the results across datacenters lets you pick the nearest one (lowest
ping) before choosing its `code` as the `datacenter_code` when creating a website setup.

actions.name: agency_hosting_change_website_domain
actions.description:
Change website domain. Changes the primary domain for an Agency Plan website.

Provide the current domain in the path and the new domain in the request body.
Set domain to null to revert to the temporary domain.

from_domain.description: Current domain name to change from

domain.description: New domain to assign to the website. Set to null to revert to the temporary domain.

actions.name: agency_hosting_link_domain_to_website
actions.description: Link domain to website. Links a domain to the specified Agency Plan website so it can serve traffic for that domain.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to link to the website

actions.name: agency_hosting_list_domains
actions.description:
List domains. Returns a paginated list of domains associated with Agency Plan websites accessible to the authenticated client.

Use the website_uuids filter to narrow results to specific websites.

actions.name: agency_hosting_unlink_domain_from_website
actions.description:
Unlink domain from website. Unlinks a domain from the specified Agency Plan website.

The website stops serving traffic on this domain immediately.

Website files and database are preserved, and any other linked domains remain accessible.

If this is the only domain on the website, unlinking leaves the website without an accessible domain.

actions.name: agency_hosting_generate_upload_url
actions.description:
Generate upload URL. Generate a file browser upload URL with authentication credentials for uploading files
to an Agency Plan website's file storage.

Returns `url`, `auth_key` and `rest_auth_key`. Use these to upload a file to the
website's file storage via the TUS resumable upload protocol (TUS 1.0.0). Send
`X-Auth: {auth_key}` and `X-Auth-Rest: {rest_auth_key}` headers on every request below.

1. Create the upload: `POST` to `{url}/{relative_file_path}?override=true` with headers
   `upload-length: {file size in bytes}` and `upload-offset: 0`. Expect `201 Created`.
2. Upload the file: send the file bytes to the same location (any TUS 1.0.0 client, or
   `PATCH` requests with an `upload...

actions.name: agency_hosting_import_website_from_archive
actions.description:
Import website from archive. Imports an Agency Plan website from an already-uploaded archive.

Upload the archive to the website's root directory via file browser first, then provide its
filename in this request. Website contents are overwritten by the archive contents. Supported
archive types: .zip, .tar, .tar.gz, .tgz.

archive_name.description: Archive filename (e.g., archive.zip). The file must already be uploaded to the website's .h5g/ directory.

actions.name: agency_hosting_list_agency_plan_order_disk_usage_metrics
actions.description:
List Agency Plan order disk usage metrics. Returns aggregated disk and inode usage for the Agency Plan order over the
selected time frame, plus the plan quotas. Figures cover the whole order
account. Values may be up to one hour stale. CPU, memory, and process usage
are on the resource-usage-metrics endpoint.

time_frame_days.description: Length of the window in days, ending now. Bucket size grows with the window.

actions.name: agency_hosting_list_orders
actions.description: List orders. Returns a paginated list of Agency Plan orders accessible to the authenticated client.

actions.name: agency_hosting_list_order_resource_usage_metrics
actions.description:
List order resource usage metrics. Returns aggregated CPU, memory, and process usage for the Agency Plan order
over the selected time frame, plus the plan quotas and a per-website
breakdown. Each website is identified by uid. Suspended and deleted websites
are excluded from both the order totals and the per-website breakdown.
Values may be up to one hour stale. Disk and inode usage are on the
disk-usage-metrics endpoint.

time_frame_hours.description: Length of the window in hours, ending now. Bucket size grows with the window.

actions.name: agency_hosting_list_php_extensions_for_website
actions.description: List PHP extensions for a website. Lists every PHP extension available to an Agency Plan website and whether it is currently enabled.

actions.name: agency_hosting_replace_website_php_extensions
actions.description: Replace website PHP extensions. Replaces the set of PHP extensions enabled on an Agency Plan website with the ones provided. Any toggleable extension not in the request is disabled, so call the extensions endpoint first and send the full desired set. Extensions compiled into PHP, reported with the "built-in" state, are always active and are unaffected.

extensions.description: Extension names, exactly as returned by the extensions endpoint.

actions.name: agency_hosting_list_php_options_for_website
actions.description: List PHP options for a website. Lists the php.ini directives that can be configured for an Agency Plan website, each with its default, the value currently in effect, and the values it accepts.

actions.name: agency_hosting_replace_website_php_options
actions.description: Replace website PHP options. Replaces the custom php.ini values on an Agency Plan website with the ones provided. Any option not in the request is reset to its default, so call the options endpoint first and send the full desired set. Sending an empty array resets every option to its default.

options.description: Option names and values. Each name must be one of the options returned by the options endpoint, and each value must satisfy that option's allowed_values when it declares them.

name.description: php.ini directive name.

actions.name: agency_hosting_list_available_php_versions_for_order
actions.description: List available PHP versions for an order. Lists the PHP versions available to websites created under an Agency Plan order, determined by the server the order is hosted on. Use this before creating a website; for a website that already exists, call the website-scoped versions endpoint instead.

actions.name: agency_hosting_list_available_php_versions_for_website
actions.description: List available PHP versions for a website. Lists the PHP versions an Agency Plan website can be switched to. The version the website is currently running is returned as settings.php.version by the website details endpoint.

actions.name: agency_hosting_update_website_php_version
actions.description: Update website PHP version. Switches an Agency Plan website to a different PHP version. Call the available versions endpoint first to see which versions can be selected. The website restarts on the new version, so requests served during the switch may fail and code that is incompatible with the target version will break.

version.description: PHP version to switch the website to, as major.minor. Must be one of the versions returned by the available versions endpoint.

actions.name: agency_hosting_create_new_website
actions.description:
Create a new website. Provisions a new website on one of your Agency Plan hosting orders.

Choose the datacenter, stack (`flavor`), and PHP version for the site. Optionally attach
your own `domain` — omit it, set it to `null`, or leave it unavailable and a free
`*.hostingersite.com` subdomain is generated instead — and/or install WordPress by
supplying the `wordpress` details (admin account, site title, and language).

Common setups:
- **Plain PHP site**: `flavor` set to `php-fpm`, with `settings.php.version`; omit
  `wordpress` and `type`.
- **WordPress site**: `flavor` set to the desired WordPress version (e.g. `wp-7.0`), plus
  the `wordpress` block (admin account, title, language).
- ...

datacenter_code.description: Datacenter code where the website should be provisioned. Available codes depend on live capacity and are not a fixed set.

flavor.description: Setup flavor: a specific WordPress version in the format `wp-<major>.<minor>` or `wp-<major>.<minor>.<patch>` (e.g. `wp-6.8.2`), or `php-fpm` for a plain PHP stack. Generic versions like `wp-latest` are not allowed.

domain.description: Primary domain to attach to the website. Omit or set to null to get a free auto-generated *.hostingersite.com subdomain instead.

actions.name: agency_hosting_get_website_setup_status
actions.description:
Get website setup status. Returns the current status of an Agency Plan website setup started via the setups
endpoint.

Poll this endpoint using the `setup_uuid` returned from the provisioning request until
`status` becomes `completed`, at which point `website_uid` identifies the new website.

actions.name: agency_hosting_reinstall_website_ssl
actions.description:
Reinstall website SSL. Replaces the Let's Encrypt certificate of the domain: the current platform certificate, when
one is recorded, is revoked and removed, then a new setup starts in the background. Returns at
once; `Get website SSL status` reports `installing` while it runs, then `active` or `failed`.

Returns 422 for free subdomains, when a certificate process is recorded for the domain (a
failed setup counts until it is cleaned up), or when the domain hit its limit of three setups
per seven days. Returns 429 when the same domain was requested less than a minute ago, and 403
when the website is suspended or locked, and 404 when the website or the domain does not exist.

actions.name: agency_hosting_install_website_ssl
actions.description:
Install website SSL. Starts a Let's Encrypt certificate setup for the domain and returns at once; the setup runs in
the background. `Get website SSL status` reports `installing` while it runs, then `active` or
`failed`; the `ssl_setup` entry of `List website processes` shows the same progress.

Returns 422 when the domain already has a platform certificate that is not expired, when a
certificate process is recorded for the domain (a failed setup counts until it is cleaned up),
or when the domain hit its limit of three setups per seven days. Returns 429 when the same
domain was requested less than a minute ago, 403 when the website is suspended or locked, and
404 when the website or the do...

actions.name: agency_hosting_get_website_ssl_status
actions.description:
Get website SSL status. Returns the SSL state of one domain of an Agency Plan website: the certificate `status`,
whether the certificate was uploaded by the customer, and when it stops being valid.

`installing` means a certificate setup is running or retrying; the `ssl_setup` entry of
`List website processes` shows the same progress. `active` means a valid certificate is in
place: uploaded by the customer, issued by the platform, or a lifetime certificate bought for
the domain. `failed` means the last setup gave up and no valid certificate is in place.
`expired` means the certificate has run out. `not_installed` means the domain has no
certificate and no setup process. Returns 404 when t...

actions.name: agency_hosting_uninstall_website_ssl
actions.description:
Uninstall website SSL. Removes the platform-issued Let's Encrypt certificate of the domain: the certificate is revoked
and deleted before the response, so the domain is no longer served with a platform certificate
until a new setup completes. Also succeeds when the domain has no platform certificate to
remove. Uploaded (custom) certificates are not affected.

Returns 422 when a certificate process is recorded for the domain (a failed setup counts until
it is cleaned up), 429 when the same domain was requested less than a minute ago, and 403 when
the website is suspended or locked, and 404 when the website or the domain does not exist.

actions.name: agency_hosting_build_website_nodejs_assets
actions.description:
Build website NodeJS assets. Builds and deploys a Node.js application for an Agency Plan website from an already-uploaded archive.

Upload the archive to file browser first, then provide its relative path from document root in this request.
Website contents are overwritten by the build result, which is deployed to public_html.

archive_path.description: Directory, relative to the website document root, where the uploaded site archive currently lives. Most commonly this is simply `public_html`.

actions.name: agency_hosting_clear_website_cache
actions.description:
Clear website cache. Clears cache for all domains associated with an Agency Plan website, including its preview domain.

This operation clears all cache types for the website.

actions.name: agency_hosting_list_website_cron_jobs
actions.description:
List website cron jobs. Returns a paginated list of cron jobs configured for an Agency Plan website.

Each entry includes the schedule expression and the command executed on that schedule.

actions.name: agency_hosting_create_website_cron_job
actions.description:
Create website cron job. Creates a cron job for an Agency Plan website from a schedule expression and a command.

Returns the created cron job, including its uuid, which is required to delete the cron job.

command.description: Command to run on the schedule. Must not contain pipe (|) or redirection (<, >) characters.

actions.name: agency_hosting_delete_website_cron_job
actions.description:
Delete website cron job. Permanently deletes the cron job identified by its uuid from an Agency Plan website.

The operation is idempotent: deleting a cron job that does not exist succeeds without error.

uuid.description: Unique identifier of the cron job as returned by the list cron jobs endpoint.

actions.name: agency_hosting_list_website_databases
actions.description:
List website databases. Returns a paginated list of MySQL databases created for an Agency Plan website.

Each entry includes the database's non-system users.

actions.name: agency_hosting_create_website_database
actions.description:
Create website database. Creates a MySQL database with a dedicated user for an Agency Plan website.

The database name, username, and password must all be provided by the caller.

database_user.description: Database username to create alongside the database (alphanumeric characters).

password.description: Password for the database user (requires mixed case, letters, and numbers).

actions.name: agency_hosting_delete_website_database
actions.description:
Delete website database. Permanently deletes a MySQL database and all its data from an Agency Plan website, including its users.

The operation is idempotent: deleting a database that does not exist succeeds without error.

database_name.description: Full database name as returned by the list databases endpoint.

actions.name: agency_hosting_create_website_database_user
actions.description:
Create website database user. Creates a user for an existing database on an Agency Plan website.

Each database supports a single non-system user; creating a user for a database that already has one fails.

database_name.description: Full database name as returned by the list databases endpoint.

database_user.description: Database username to create (alphanumeric and underscores).

password.description: Password for the database user (requires mixed case, letters, and numbers).

host.description: Host the user connects from (IPv4, IPv6, % wildcard, or localhost). Defaults to localhost.

actions.name: agency_hosting_delete_website_database_user
actions.description:
Delete website database user. Permanently deletes a database user from an Agency Plan website database, revoking all access it had.

The operation is idempotent: deleting a user that does not exist succeeds without error.

database_name.description: Full database name as returned by the list databases endpoint.

database_user_name.description: Database username as returned by the list databases endpoint.

actions.name: agency_hosting_get_website_details
actions.description:
Get website details. Retrieves detailed information about a specific Agency Plan website, including configuration,
status, metadata, hosting plan details, and resource quotas.

actions.name: agency_hosting_delete_website
actions.description:
Delete website. Permanently deletes an Agency Plan website. Deletion is processed asynchronously: the
website is immediately transitioned to a deleting state and the underlying server
resources are removed in the background.

actions.name: agency_hosting_list_agency_plan_websites
actions.description:
List Agency Plan websites. Retrieve a paginated list of Agency Plan websites (H5G, Builder, and Horizons) accessible to
the authenticated client.

This endpoint returns websites from your hosting accounts as well as
websites from other client hosting accounts that have shared access
with you.

The response shape differs per platform — see the `platform` field on each item.

Use `website_types` to list only websites of a given detected type, e.g. only
WordPress websites (`website_types=wordpress`) or only Node.js websites
(`website_types=nodejs`). Combine with `order_ids`, `states`, or `domain` for more
targeted results.

order_ids.description: Filter by order IDs. Accepts a comma-separated list.

states.description: Filter by website state. Accepts a comma-separated list.

website_types.description: Filter by detected website type, e.g. wordpress,nodejs. Accepts a comma-separated list.

domain.description: Filter by domain name (case-insensitive substring match)

actions.name: agency_hosting_list_website_processes
actions.description:
List website processes. Lists active and recently completed asynchronous processes for an Agency Plan website.

Each process has a unique ID (for tracking), a type, and a status (running, completed, failed).
Poll this endpoint after initiating async operations (SSL setup, backups, cloning) to track progress.

actions.name: agency_hosting_change_wordpress_version
actions.description: Change WordPress version. Changes the installed WordPress core version on an Agency Plan website to one of the versions available for installation.

version.description: Target WordPress core version to install. Must be one of the available versions.

actions.name: agency_hosting_get_wordpress_settings
actions.description:
Get WordPress settings. Returns the current WordPress settings for an Agency Plan website: installed core version,
LiteSpeed Cache plugin status, object cache status, and maintenance mode status.

actions.name: agency_hosting_list_available_wordpress_versions
actions.description: List available WordPress versions. Lists the WordPress core versions available for installation on an Agency Plan website.

actions.name: agent_readiness_list_checks
actions.description:
List checks. List every check an agent readiness scan runs, with its name, category and weight.\n
Use it to show the human-readable name of each `check_id` in a scan's results.

actions.name: agent_readiness_run_agent_readiness_scan
actions.description:
Run agent readiness scan. Start a scan of how ready a public website is for AI agents to discover, read and act on.\n
Scanning is asynchronous: this operation only starts the scan, and the returned scan is usually `pending`
with no results yet. To get the results, poll the `Get agent readiness scan` operation with the same
domain every few seconds until its status is `completed` or `failed`. The scan itself is limited to 60 seconds,
plus any time it waits in the queue. A `failed` scan is not retried; run this operation again.\n
Starting a scan for a domain that already has a pending scan from the last 5 minutes
returns that scan instead of starting a new one.

domain.description: Domain name or full URL of the website to scan. Only the host is used.

actions.name: agent_readiness_get_agent_readiness_scan
actions.description:
Get agent readiness scan. Get the latest agent readiness scan of a website.\n
Scans started with the `Run agent readiness scan` operation are asynchronous. While the status is
`pending`, the result fields are null; wait a few seconds and call this operation again until the status is
`completed` or `failed`. A `failed` scan is not retried; run the scan again.\n
A completed scan has a 0-100 score, a letter grade, a score per category, and the result of every
check with the evidence found and how to fix it. Check names are listed by the `List checks` operation.\n
Returns 404 when the domain has never been scanned; use the `Run agent readiness scan` operation first.

domain.description: Domain name the scan was run for

actions.name: billing_get_catalog_item_list
actions.description:
Get catalog item list. Retrieve catalog items available for order.

Prices in catalog items is displayed as cents (without floating point),
e.g: float `17.99` is displayed as integer `1799`.

Use this endpoint to view available services and pricing before placing orders.

name.description: Filter catalog items by name. Use `*` for wildcard search, e.g. `.COM*` to find .com domain

actions.name: billing_create_purchase_order
actions.description:
Create purchase order. Create a purchase order for any Hostinger product.

This unified endpoint places an order for one or more catalog items and
works across all Hostinger products, leveraging the existing billing
infrastructure. Use the [catalog endpoint](#tag/billing-catalog) to look
up the `item_id` values available for purchase.

If no payment method is provided, your default payment method will be used automatically.

If the response is `202 Accepted`, the payment is still being processed and the order will
complete asynchronously once the payment is confirmed.

This endpoint only places the order. Product-specific provisioning
(e.g. VPS setup or domain registration) is not perform...

payment_method_id.description: Payment method ID, default will be used if not provided

actions.name: billing_set_default_payment_method
actions.description:
Set default payment method. Set the default payment method for your account.

Use this endpoint to configure the primary payment method for future orders.

actions.name: billing_delete_payment_method
actions.description:
Delete payment method. Delete a payment method from your account.

Use this endpoint to remove unused payment methods from user accounts.

actions.name: billing_get_payment_method_list
actions.description:
Get payment method list. Retrieve available payment methods that can be used for placing new orders.

If you want to add new payment method,
please use [hPanel](https://hpanel.hostinger.com/billing/payment-methods).

Use this endpoint to view available payment options before creating orders.

actions.name: billing_get_subscription_list
actions.description:
Get subscription list. Retrieve a list of all subscriptions associated with your account.

Use this endpoint to monitor active services and billing status.

actions.name: billing_disable_auto_renewal
actions.description:
Disable auto-renewal for a subscription.

Use this endpoint when disable auto-renewal for a subscription.

actions.name: billing_enable_auto_renewal
actions.description:
Enable auto-renewal for a subscription.

Use this endpoint when enable auto-renewal for a subscription.

actions.name: billing_renew_subscription
actions.description:
Renew subscription. Create a renewal order for an existing Hostinger subscription.

This endpoint places a renewal order for a single subscription, leveraging
the existing billing infrastructure. Use the
[subscriptions endpoint](#tag/billing-subscriptions) to look up the
`subscriptionId` values available for renewal.

If no payment method is provided, your default payment method will be used automatically.

If the response is `202 Accepted`, the payment is still being processed and the renewal will
complete asynchronously once the payment is confirmed.

Use this endpoint to renew any subscription available in your account.

payment_method_id.description: Payment method ID, default will be used if not provided

actions.name: dns_get_dns_snapshot
actions.description:
Get DNS snapshot. Retrieve particular DNS snapshot with contents of DNS zone records.

Use this endpoint to view historical DNS configurations for domains.

actions.name: dns_get_dns_snapshot_list
actions.description:
Get DNS snapshot list. Retrieve DNS snapshots for a domain.

Use this endpoint to view available DNS backup points for restoration.

actions.name: dns_restore_dns_snapshot
actions.description:
Restore DNS snapshot. Restore DNS zone to the selected snapshot.

Use this endpoint to revert domain DNS to a previous configuration.

actions.name: dns_get_dns_records
actions.description:
Get DNS records. Retrieve DNS zone records for a specific domain.

Use this endpoint to view current DNS configuration for domain management.

actions.name: dns_update_dns_records
actions.description:
Update DNS records for the selected domain.

Using `overwrite = true` will replace existing records with the provided ones. 
Otherwise existing records will be updated and new records will be added.

Use this endpoint to modify domain DNS configuration.

overwrite.description:
If `true`, resource records (RRs) matching name and type will be deleted and new RRs will be created,
otherwise resource records' ttl's are updated and new records are appended.
If no matching RRs are found, they are created.

name.description: Name of the record (use `@` for wildcard name)

actions.name: dns_delete_dns_records
actions.description:
Delete DNS records for the selected domain.

To filter which records to delete, add the `name` of the record and `type` to the filter. 
Multiple filters can be provided with single request.

If you have multiple records with the same name and type, and you want to delete only part of them,
refer to the `Update zone records` endpoint.

Use this endpoint to remove specific DNS records from domains.

name.description: Name of the record

actions.name: dns_reset_dns_records
actions.description:
Reset DNS records. Reset DNS zone to the default records.

Use this endpoint to restore domain DNS to original configuration.

sync.description: Determines if operation should be run synchronously

reset_email_records.description: Determines if email records should be reset

whitelisted_record_types.description: Specifies which record types to not reset

actions.name: dns_validate_dns_records
actions.description:
Validate DNS records prior to update for the selected domain.

If the validation is successful, the response will contain `200 Success` code.
If there is validation error, the response will fail with `422 Validation error` code.

Use this endpoint to verify DNS record validity before applying changes.

overwrite.description:
If `true`, resource records (RRs) matching name and type will be deleted and new RRs will be created,
otherwise resource records' ttl's are updated and new records are appended.
If no matching RRs are found, they are created.

name.description: Name of the record (use `@` for wildcard name)

actions.name: domains_get_verifications
actions.description: Get domain verifications. Retrieve a list of pending and completed domain verifications.

domains.description: The list of domains for which to get verification details for.

actions.name: domains_suggest_domain_names_from_description
actions.description:
Suggest domain names from a description. Suggest available domain names based on a free-text description of your project.

Suggestions are generated by an AI model, so they differ between calls.

Endpoint has rate limit of 90 requests per minute.

Use this endpoint to find a domain name when you only know what the website is about.

description.description: Free-text description of the project the domain is needed for

limit.description: Amount of domain names to suggest

actions.name: domains_suggest_domain_names_from_domain
actions.description:
Suggest domain names from a domain. Suggest available domain names based on a domain name you already have in mind.

Suggestions are generated by an AI model, so they differ between calls.

Endpoint has rate limit of 90 requests per minute.

Use this endpoint when the domain you wanted is taken and you need close alternatives.

domain.description: Domain name to base the suggestions on

limit.description: Amount of domain names to suggest

actions.name: domains_check_domain_availability
actions.description:
Check domain availability. Check availability of domain names across multiple TLDs.

Multiple TLDs can be checked at once.
If you want alternative domains with response, provide only one TLD and set `with_alternatives` to `true`.
TLDs should be provided without leading dot (e.g. `com`, `net`, `org`).

Endpoint has rate limit of 90 requests per minute.

Use this endpoint to verify domain availability before purchase.

actions.name: domains_get_domain_forwarding
actions.description:
Get domain forwarding. Retrieve domain forwarding data.

Use this endpoint to view current redirect configuration for domains.

actions.name: domains_update_domain_forwarding
actions.description:
Update domain forwarding configuration.

Use this endpoint to modify existing redirect configuration for domains.

actions.name: domains_delete_domain_forwarding
actions.description:
Delete domain forwarding data.

Use this endpoint to remove redirect configuration from domains.

actions.name: domains_create_domain_forwarding
actions.description:
Create domain forwarding configuration.

Use this endpoint to set up domain redirects to other URLs.

actions.name: domains_get_pending_irtp_verification
actions.description:
Get pending IRTP verification. Retrieve a pending IRTP verification for a domain.

Both the old and new registrant must confirm it before the WHOIS change takes effect.

Use this endpoint to check the status of a WHOIS change awaiting registrant confirmation.

actions.name: domains_cancel_pending_irtp_verification
actions.description:
Cancel pending IRTP verification. Cancel a pending IRTP verification.

Use this endpoint to back out of a WHOIS change that is stuck waiting on registrant confirmation,
for example when the confirmation email cannot be received, without waiting out the 5-day expiry.

actions.name: domains_get_incoming_domain_move
actions.description:
Get incoming domain move. Retrieve the incoming move for a specified domain.

Returns 404 when no account is moving this domain to you.

Use this endpoint to check whether a domain addressed to you is still waiting to be accepted.

force_sync.description: Re-check the move against the registry before responding. Only has an effect while the move is in the `activating` status.

actions.name: domains_accept_incoming_domain_move
actions.description:
Accept incoming domain move. Accept an incoming move for a specified domain.

The provided WHOIS profiles become the contacts of the domain, so they must belong
to your account and satisfy the requirements of the TLD. Only the contact types the
domain actually uses are applied, but all four profile IDs have to be provided.

The move has to still be waiting for your decision, already accepted moves
cannot be accepted again.

Accepting does not complete the move. A confirmation email is sent to the email address of
the new owner contact, and the domain changes hands only after the change is confirmed from it.
Until then the move stays in the `activating` status, which can be followed with t...

domain_contacts.description: WHOIS profiles of the accepting account. Only the contact types required by the TLD are applied, but all four IDs must be provided.

actions.name: domains_reject_incoming_domain_move
actions.description:
Reject incoming domain move. Reject an incoming move for a specified domain.

The domain stays in the account which initiated the move.
Moves you have already accepted cannot be rejected anymore.

Use this endpoint to decline a domain you do not want to take over.

actions.name: domains_get_incoming_domain_move_list
actions.description:
Get incoming domain move list. Retrieve all domains other Hostinger accounts are moving to your account.

Moves of every status are returned, including the ones which already completed.

Use this endpoint to find domains waiting for you to accept them.

actions.name: domains_get_outgoing_domain_move
actions.description:
Get outgoing domain move. Retrieve the outgoing move for a specified domain.

Returns 404 when the domain has no move in progress.

Use this endpoint to track the status of a move you have initiated for a single domain.

actions.name: domains_start_outgoing_domain_move
actions.description:
Start outgoing domain move. Initiate a move of a specified domain to another Hostinger account.

The receiving account has to already exist and accept the move before the domain changes hands.

The domain must be active. The subscription it belongs to is resolved automatically,
and the request is rejected with a 404 status code when the domain has no domain
subscription of its own.

Domains protected by premium protection require an additional verification step,
such requests are rejected with a 428 status code.

Use this endpoint to hand a domain over to another Hostinger user.

actions.name: domains_cancel_outgoing_domain_move

actions.name: domains_get_outgoing_domain_move_list
actions.description:
Get outgoing domain move list. Retrieve all domains you are moving to other Hostinger accounts.

Use this endpoint to track moves you have initiated and the accounts they are addressed to.

actions.name: domains_get_domain_authorization_code

actions.description:

actions.name: domains_get_domain_details
actions.description:
Get domain details. Retrieve detailed information for specified domain.

Use this endpoint to view comprehensive domain configuration and status.

actions.name: domains_get_domain_list
actions.description:
Get domain list. Retrieve all domains associated with your account.

Use this endpoint to view user's domain portfolio.

actions.name: domains_purchase_new_domain
actions.description:
Purchase new domain. Purchase and register a new domain name.

If registration fails, login to [hPanel](https://hpanel.hostinger.com/) and check domain registration status.

actions.description:
Enable privacy protection for the domain.

When privacy protection is enabled, domain owner's personal information is hidden from public WHOIS database.

Use this endpoint to protect domain owner's personal information from public view.

actions.name: domains_disable_privacy_protection
actions.description:
Disable privacy protection for the domain.

When privacy protection is disabled, domain owner's personal information is visible in public WHOIS database.

Use this endpoint to make domain owner's information publicly visible.

actions.name: domains_get_domain_renewal_information
actions.description:
Get domain renewal information. Retrieve renewal information for a specified domain, including its status and current
expiration date.

Use this endpoint to build renewal automation and expiry monitoring for a single domain.

actions.description:
Complete domain setup. Register a domain you have already paid for but which has not been set up yet.

Use this endpoint when an order completed without registering the domain, for example when
`Purchase new domain` returned `202 Accepted` and the domain was added to your account without

Complete the missing information,...

actions.description:
Update domain nameservers. Set nameservers for a specified domain.

Use this endpoint to configure custom DNS hosting for domains.

actions.description:

actions.description:
Get transfer. Retrieve the transfer for a specified domain.

actions.name: domains_get_transfer_list
actions.description:
Get transfer list. Retrieve all domain transfers in your portfolio.

actions.name: domains_start_domain_transfer
actions.description:
Start domain transfer. Transfer a domain from another registrar to your account.

actions.description:

actions.name: domains_set_whois_profile_as_default
actions.description:
Set WHOIS profile as default. Set WHOIS contact profile as default.

The default profile is pre-selected for the TLD it belongs to when registering new domains.

Use this endpoint to avoid picking contact information for every registration.

actions.name: domains_unset_default_whois_profile
actions.description:
Unset default WHOIS profile. Unset WHOIS contact profile as default.

The profile itself is kept, it is only no longer pre-selected for its TLD.

Use this endpoint to stop reusing contact information for new registrations.

actions.name: domains_get_whois_profile
actions.description:
Get WHOIS profile. Retrieve a WHOIS contact profile.

actions.description:

actions.description:

actions.description:

actions.description:

actions.name: ecommerce_list_discounts
actions.description:
List discounts. List a store's discounts. Filter by free text over code and name, or by disabled state.
Amounts for fixed discounts are integers in the smallest currency unit; percentage
discounts carry a whole-number value between 1 and 100.

store_id.description: The ID of the store to list discounts for.

q.description: Free-text search over discount code and name.

actions.name: ecommerce_create_discount
actions.description:
Create a discount for a store. Fixed discounts take an amount in the smallest currency
unit (e.g. $10 is 1000); percentage discounts take a whole-number value between 1 and 100.
Free-shipping discounts ignore value. Returns the created discount.

store_id.description: The ID of the store to create the discount for.

code.description: The discount code customers enter at checkout.

name.description: A human-friendly discount name.

value.description: For percentage discounts a whole number 1-100; for fixed discounts an amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g. $10 is 1000). Ignored for free_shipping.

allocation.description: Whether the discount applies to the cart total or to each eligible item.

starts_at.description: When the discount becomes active. A bare date (2026-11-27) anchors to time_zone. Defaults to now when omitted.

ends_at.description: When the discount expires. A bare date runs to the end of that day in time_zone. Never expires when omitted.

usage_limit.description: Maximum number of times the discount can be redeemed.

min_cart_value.description: Minimum cart value in the smallest currency unit required for the discount to apply.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone used to interpret starts_at and ends_at.

actions.name: ecommerce_get_custom_storefront_setup_instructions
actions.description:
Get custom storefront setup instructions. Retrieve step-by-step setup instructions, formatted as Markdown, for connecting a custom sales
channel to your store and keeping your catalog, orders, shipping and payments in sync through
the Ecommerce API.

actions.name: ecommerce_cancel_order
actions.description: Cancel an order. Cancel the order and optionally email the customer. Returns the updated order summary.

store_id.description: The ID of the store that owns the order.

order_id.description: The ID of the order to cancel.

notify_customer.description: Whether to email the customer about the cancellation. Defaults to true.

actions.name: ecommerce_fulfil_order
actions.description:
Fulfil an order. Create a fulfilment for the order and attach tracking in one call. Omit items to fulfil
every remaining unfulfilled item. Returns the updated order summary.

store_id.description: The ID of the store that owns the order.

order_id.description: The ID of the order to fulfil.

items.description: Line items to fulfil. Omit to fulfil every remaining unfulfilled item.

line_item_id.description: The line item to fulfil, from the order detail items[].id.

quantity.description: Quantity of the line item to fulfil.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number for the shipment.

tracking_url.description: Public tracking URL for the shipment. Requires tracking_number.

notify_customer.description: Whether to email the customer about the fulfilment. Defaults to true.

actions.name: ecommerce_list_store_orders
actions.description:
List store orders. List a store's orders newest first as summaries. Filter by status, payment or fulfilment
status, customer email, order number or a free-text query. Amounts are in the smallest
currency unit. Retrieve a single order for its line items, addresses and fulfilments.

store_id.description: The ID of the store to list orders for.

payment_status.description: Payment statuses to include. A paid order is "captured".

display_id.description: The order number the merchant and customer see.

q.description: Free-text search over customer name, email, order number and line items.

created_at_from.description: Earliest creation time to include, inclusive. Accepts a date or ISO date-time (UTC).

created_at_to.description: Latest creation time to include, inclusive. A bare date covers that whole day.

actions.name: ecommerce_retrieve_order
actions.description:
Retrieve an order. Retrieve one order in full: line items (each with the id the fulfil endpoint needs),
addresses, the totals breakdown and fulfilments with tracking. Amounts are in the
smallest currency unit.

store_id.description: The ID of the store that owns the order.

order_id.description: The ID of the order to retrieve.

actions.name: ecommerce_enable_manual_payment_method
actions.description: Enable manual payment method. Enable a manual payment method so the store can accept orders without an online payment provider.

store_id.description: The ID of the store to enable manual payment for.

title.description: Optional display name shown to customers at checkout.

actions.name: ecommerce_create_payment_provider_connect_link
actions.description:
Create a payment provider connect link. Create an onboarding link for connecting a payment gateway to the store. Returns the gateway
onboarding URL for the merchant to open and a deep-link into the store admin.

store_id.description: The ID of the store to connect the payment provider to.

provider_id.description: The ID of the payment gateway to connect, e.g. stripe.

actions.name: ecommerce_list_store_payment_providers
actions.description:
List store payment providers. List a store's payment providers, split into providers already connected to the store and
gateways available to install. Never exposes gateway credentials, secrets, or configuration.

store_id.description: The ID of the store to list payment providers for.

include_currency_unsupported.description: Include gateways that do not support the store currency in the available list.

actions.name: ecommerce_create_product_image_upload_url
actions.description:
Create a product image upload URL. Returns a signed URL to upload a product image to (multipart/form-data POST). Then call the
attach-image endpoint with the returned object_name to scan and attach it to the product.

store_id.description: The ID of the store the product belongs to.

product_id.description: The ID of the product the image will be attached to.

actions.name: ecommerce_delete_product
actions.description:
Delete a product and its variants from the store. A subscription product with active
subscribers is archived instead of deleted so its data stays available.

store_id.description: The ID of the store that owns the product.

product_id.description: The ID of the product to delete.

actions.name: ecommerce_update_product
actions.description:
Update a product's name, description, status, SEO settings or collections. Set status to
published to make it buyable, draft to hide it, or archived to retire it. SEO settings (title,
description, slug) left out keep their values. collection_changes adds or removes collections
without touching the others. Variants, prices and inventory are managed through the variant
endpoints, not here. Returns the updated product summary.

store_id.description: The ID of the store that owns the product.

product_id.description: The ID of the product to update.

name.description: The product name.

status.description: Set "published" to make the product buyable, "draft" to hide it, or "archived" to retire it.

seo_settings.description: Search-engine settings to change. Send at least one field; omitted fields keep their current values.

title.description: Search-engine title for the product page.

description.description: Search-engine description for the product page.

slug.description: URL slug of the product page. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

collection_changes.description: Adds the product to or removes it from collections without touching its other collections. Send at least one collection in add or remove.

add.description: Collections to add the product to. Every id must exist in the store.

remove.description: Collections to take the product out of. Ids the product is not in are ignored.

actions.name: ecommerce_create_digital_product
actions.description: Create digital product. Create a published digital product with a single variant and an optional external download link.

store_id.description: The ID of the store to create the product in.

name.description: The product name.

price.description: Price in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents). Must be positive.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to the store's default currency when omitted.

download_url.description: Optional external download link delivered to the customer after purchase.

actions.name: ecommerce_list_products
actions.description:
List products. List a store's products newest first as lean summaries (name, status, thumbnail, variant
count and price range). Prices are integers in the smallest currency unit and live on
variants. Filter by status, free text or a set of product ids. Use include=variants to
embed each product's variants with prices and inventory, and include=media to embed its media.

store_id.description: The ID of the store to list products for.

product_ids.description: Restrict to these product ids. Doubles as a single-product lookup. Up to 200 ids.

q.description: Free-text search over product title and SKU.

include.description: Opt-in heavy data: "variants" embeds each product's variants; "media" embeds its media.

actions.name: ecommerce_create_physical_product
actions.description: Create physical product. Create a published physical product with a single variant priced in the store currency.

store_id.description: The ID of the store to create the product in.

name.description: The product name.

price.description: Price in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents). Must be positive.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to the store's default currency when omitted.

seo_settings.description: Search-engine settings. Omitted fields are generated from the name and description; a slug already in use gets a numeric suffix. Send at least one field.

title.description: Search-engine title for the product page.

description.description: Search-engine description for the product page.

slug.description: URL slug of the product page. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

actions.name: ecommerce_upload_and_attach_product_image
actions.description:
Upload and attach a product image. Fetch a raster image (JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP, max 15MB) from a URL and attach it to a product in a
single call. Image downloads require HTTPS on port 443 without embedded credentials. At most one redirect
is allowed, and its destination must meet the same requirements. Private or reserved network
destinations, unsupported URLs and longer redirect chains are rejected. The image is virus-scanned
and validated by content, then stored on the CDN. Set is_thumbnail to make it the product's primary image.

store_id.description: The ID of the store the product belongs to.

product_id.description: The ID of the product to attach the image to.

image_url.description:
Publicly reachable URL of a raster image (JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP), maximum 15MB. Fetching
the image requires HTTPS on port 443 without embedded credentials. At most one redirect
is allowed; its destination must meet the same URL requirements. Private or reserved
network destinations, unsupported URLs and longer redirect chains are rejected. The image
is fetched, virus-scanned and validated by content, then stored on the CDN. SVG is not
accepted. Provide either this or object_name.

object_name.description: Key returned by the upload-url endpoint. Provide this instead of image_url to attach an uploaded image.

is_thumbnail.description:
When true, the image becomes the product's thumbnail (primary image). When omitted, it becomes the
thumbnail only if the product does not have one yet.

actions.name: ecommerce_list_sales_channels
actions.description: List sales channels. List a store's active sales channels with their full metadata.

store_id.description: The ID of the store to list sales channels for.

actions.name: ecommerce_create_sales_channel
actions.description:
Create a sales channel for a store. A "custom" channel is headless: build your own frontend and keep
your catalog, orders, shipping and payments in sync through the Ecommerce API. A "quick-link" channel
is a hosted one-page store whose handle is auto-generated.

store_id.description: The ID of the store to create the sales channel for.

type.description:
Sales channel type. "custom" is a headless channel: it requires a name and takes an optional public url.
"quick-link" is a one-page store whose handle is auto-generated; it supports neither name nor url.

name.description: Merchant-facing custom name. Required for custom channels; not supported for quick-link.

url.description: Optional public url for the channel. Custom channels only; not supported for quick-link.

actions.name: ecommerce_update_sales_channel
actions.description:
Update sales channel. Update a custom sales channel. The merchant-facing `name` and the public `url`
(returned as the channel `domain`) can be changed. Pass `null` to clear a value.

store_id.description: The ID of the store that owns the sales channel.

sales_channel_id.description: The ID of the sales channel to update.

name.description: Merchant-facing custom name shown in the sales channels list. Pass null to clear it.

url.description: Public address where the custom sales channel lives. Pass null to clear it.

actions.name: ecommerce_set_store_shipping
actions.description: Set store shipping. Set the flat-rate shipping price for a store, creating the shipping zone if it does not exist yet.

store_id.description: The ID of the store to configure shipping for.

price.description: Flat shipping rate in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents). Use 0 for free shipping.

actions.name: ecommerce_delete_store
actions.description:
Delete store. Soft-delete a store owned by your account.

The underlying store data is preserved; only the store is marked as deleted.

store_id.description: The ID of the store to delete.

actions.name: ecommerce_get_stores
actions.description: Get stores. Retrieve the stores associated with your account.

actions.name: ecommerce_create_store
actions.description:
Create store. Create a new store for your account.

A primary sales channel is created alongside the store.

type.description: Sales channel type. Only "custom" channels can be created via the API.

external_id.description: External identifier for the sales channel.

actions.name: ecommerce_get_store_metadata
actions.description:
Get store metadata. Get a store's readiness metadata: whether payment methods and shipping are configured,
plus its default currency. Useful to verify prerequisites before building a storefront.

store_id.description: The ID of the store to read metadata for.

actions.name: ecommerce_update_product_variants_in_batch
actions.description:
Update product variants in batch. Update up to 100 existing variants in place by id — title, SKU, inventory, stock tracking
and prices. Variants omitted from the request are left untouched. Prices replace the variant's
existing prices in full. Returns the updated variants.

store_id.description: The ID of the store that owns the product.

product_id.description: The ID of the product whose variants are being updated.

variants.description: Variants to update in place by id, up to 100. Variants omitted from the list are left untouched.

variant_id.description: The id of the variant to update.

manage_inventory.description: Whether stock is tracked for this variant.

prices.description: The full list of prices for the variant, replacing the existing ones. A free item is amount: 0.

amount.description: Price in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

sale_amount.description: Optional sale price in the smallest currency unit; must be lower than amount.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to the store's default currency.

actions.name: ecommerce_delete_product_variant
actions.description: Delete a product variant. Delete a single variant from the product.

store_id.description: The ID of the store that owns the product.

product_id.description: The ID of the product that owns the variant.

variant_id.description: The ID of the variant to delete.

actions.name: ecommerce_list_product_variants
actions.description:
List product variants. List a product's variants, ordered by rank, with their options, prices and inventory.
Prices are integers in the smallest currency unit and live on variants.

store_id.description: The ID of the store that owns the product.

product_id.description: The ID of the product to list variants for.

actions.name: ecommerce_create_product_variant
actions.description:
Create a product variant. Add a variant to a product along one or more option dimensions (e.g. Size, Color). Options
missing from the product are created automatically; provide a value for every option the
product already has. Prices are integers in the smallest currency unit and default to the
store currency. Returns the created variant.

store_id.description: The ID of the store that owns the product.

product_id.description: The ID of the product to add the variant to.

title.description: The variant title. Defaults to the option values joined with ' / ' (e.g. 'Red / L').

options.description: Option name/value pairs that distinguish this variant, e.g. [{name: Size, value: M}]. Options missing from the product are created; provide a value for every option the product already has.

name.description: Option name, e.g. Size.

value.description: Option value for this variant, e.g. M.

prices.description: Prices per currency. Amounts are integers in the smallest currency unit. A free item is amount: 0.

amount.description: Price in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

sale_amount.description: Optional sale price in the smallest currency unit; must be lower than amount.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to the store's default currency when omitted.

manage_inventory.description: Whether stock is tracked for this variant. Defaults to false.

actions.name: horizons_clone_website
actions.description:
Clone website. Clone a Hostinger Horizons website into a new website.\n
Use this tool when the user wants a copy of an existing website, for example to try out
changes without touching the original.\n
This tool returns the ID and URL of the newly created copy.
The original website is left untouched.\n
To edit the copy, use the `Edit website` tool with the returned website ID, or the user can
open the provided website URL in Hostinger Horizons interface.

actions.name: horizons_get_website_list
actions.description:
Get website list. List the Hostinger Horizons websites the user owns.\n
Use this tool when the user asks which websites they have, or when you need a website ID
before editing, publishing or cloning a website.\n
Each website is returned with its ID, status, domain and the URL to open it
in Hostinger Horizons interface.\n
The complete list of websites is returned in a single response - it is not paginated.

actions.name: horizons_create_website
actions.description:
Create website. Create new Hostinger Horizons website from the given message.\n
Use this tool when user asks you to create a website, landing page, blog
or any other type of application.\n
This tool initiates the website creation process and returns a website URL and ID.
The generation happens asynchronously.\n
After invoking this tool, your chat reply must be EXACTLY 1 sentence summarizing
that Hostinger Horizons is now creating their website and it will be ready in a few minutes
and you should provide the website URL to the user immediately
Do not write code.\n\nTo edit afterwards, use the `Edit website` tool with the returned
website ID, or the user can go to Hostinger Horizons interfa...

text.description:
Detailed project specification.
Include purpose, key features, user flows, data models, and design preferences.
The specification should be detailed and comprehensive, covering all aspects of the project.

actions.name: horizons_edit_website
actions.description:
Edit website. Edit an existing Hostinger Horizons website with a follow-up message.\n
Use this tool when the user wants to change, extend or fix a website that already exists.\n
This tool queues the requested changes and returns the website URL and ID.
The changes are applied asynchronously.\n
After invoking this tool, your chat reply must be EXACTLY 1 sentence summarizing
that Hostinger Horizons is now applying the requested changes and they will be ready
in a few minutes, and you should provide the website URL to the user immediately.
Do not write code.\n
If the tool call fails with an error, you should provide a clear explanation of the error
and do not generate code yourself in the chat.

text.description:
Detailed description of the changes to apply to the website.
Include which sections, features, content or design should change and how.
The specification should be detailed and comprehensive, covering all requested changes.

actions.name: horizons_publish_website
actions.description:
Publish website. Publish a Hostinger Horizons website so its latest changes go live.\n
Use this tool when the user asks to publish, deploy or make their website live.\n
This tool starts the publish process and returns the URL the website will be live on.
Publishing happens asynchronously and takes a few minutes.\n
Set `is_template` only when the user explicitly asks to share the website as a template:
true adds a "Use template" banner to its published pages that copies the website into the
visitor's own account, and false removes it. Leave it out to keep the current setting.\n
After invoking this tool, your chat reply must be EXACTLY 1 sentence summarizing
that the website is being publis...

is_template.description:
Set to true to publish the website as a template: its published pages show a "Use template" banner
that copies the website into the visitor's own account. Set to false to remove the banner.
Leave it out to keep the current setting.

actions.name: horizons_get_website
actions.description:
Get website. Get the link for the user to open their website in Hostinger Horizons interface.\n
Use this tool when the user wants the link to an existing website, or when you need its
website URL before or after editing it.\n

actions.name: hosting_clear_website_cache

Clear website cache. Permanently clears all server-side cache for the website at once. Use it when content was
updated and needs to be visible immediately, or after making major changes.

cache and leave the server cache untouched, use `Purge CDN cache`. For a WordPress
installation living in a subdirectory, pass the directory query parameter to clear its cache.

Directory of the website installation to clear, relative to the website root.

actions.description:
Toggle cacheless mode. Turns development (cacheless) mode on or off, based on the enabled flag. When enabled, nothing
is cached, effectively turning off all caching for the website; use it while actively developing,
testing changes, debugging issues, or when real-time updates must be visible. Disable it after

actions.name: hosting_toggle_website_cache

faster page loads, reduced server load, and improved user experience; recommended for production
websites. Disabling may impact performance; to temporarily bypass caching while developing or

load on the server. Works for the main domain, parked domains and subdomains of the account.

applies the DNS change again and refreshes the CDN SSL certificate.

server (retry after the move finishes), or when the CDN provider rejects the ...

actions.name: hosting_purge_cdn_cache

is not touched; to clear both, use `Clear website cache`.

Returns 422 when CDN is not enabled on the website. Returns 404 when the domain is not a
website on the account.

actions.name: hosting_get_cdn_status

domain, parked domains and subdomains of the account.

The domain must be the exact website name as listed on the account, without a `www.` prefix.
Returns 404 when the domain is not a website on the account.

actions.name: hosting_list_account_cron_jobs
actions.description: List account cron jobs. Returns the list of cron jobs configured for the specified account, including their schedule and command.

actions.name: hosting_create_account_cron_job

actions.name: hosting_delete_account_cron_job

actions.name: hosting_get_cron_job_output
actions.description:
Get cron job output. Returns the output captured from the last execution of the cron job identified by its uid.

The uid is returned by the list cron jobs endpoint.

uid.description: Unique identifier of the cron job as returned by the list cron jobs endpoint.

actions.name: hosting_change_database_password
actions.description:
Change database password. Changes the password for the specified database user.

The database name must be the full name returned by the list databases endpoint.
The password must also be updated in any website configuration that uses this database.

name.description: Full database name as returned by the list databases endpoint.

actions.name: hosting_list_account_databases
actions.description:
List account databases. Returns a paginated list of databases for the specified account.

Use the domain and is_assigned filters to find databases assigned to a specific domain.

actions.description:

exactly as returned by the list remote connections endpoint). The database name must be

actions.name: hosting_repair_database
actions.description:
Repair database. Repairs corrupted database tables asynchronously.

Use when database errors, crashes, or corruption are reported.

website's environment variables, then restarts the application. The platform generates the
password (and the database name and user, unless supplied). The password is never returned;

`DATABASE_URL` (`mysql://user:password@host:port/name`, user and password percent-encoded).

Get phpMyAdmin link. Returns a direct sign-on link to phpMyAdmin for the specified database.

actions.name: hosting_list_available_datacenters
actions.description:
List available datacenters. Retrieve a list of datacenters available for setting up hosting plans
based on available datacenter capacity and hosting plan of your order.
The first item in the list is the best match for your specific order
requirements.

actions.name: hosting_generate_free_subdomain
actions.description:
Generate a free subdomain. Generate a unique free subdomain that can be used for hosting services without purchasing custom domains.
Free subdomains allow you to start using hosting services immediately
and you can always connect a custom domain to your site later.

actions.description:
List website parked domains. Retrieve all parked or alias domains created under the selected website.

Use this endpoint to inspect parked domain configuration for a specific website,
including the parent domain and root directory assigned to each parked domain.

actions.name: hosting_create_website_parked_domain
actions.description:
Create website parked domain. Create a parked or alias domain for the selected website.

as the parent domain.

actions.name: hosting_delete_website_parked_domain
actions.description:
Delete website parked domain. Delete an existing parked or alias domain from the selected website.

Use this endpoint to remove parked domains that are no longer needed.

actions.name: hosting_list_website_subdomains
actions.description:
List website subdomains. Retrieve all subdomains created under the selected website.

Use this endpoint to inspect subdomain configuration for a specific website,
including the parent domain and root directory assigned to each subdomain.

actions.name: hosting_create_website_subdomain
actions.description:
Create website subdomain. Create a new subdomain for the selected website.

Delete website subdomain. Delete an existing subdomain from the selected website.

actions.name: hosting_verify_domain_ownership
actions.description:
Verify domain ownership. Verify ownership of a single domain and return the verification status.

Use this endpoint to check if a domain is accessible for you before using it for new websites.
If the domain is accessible, the response will have `is_accessible: true`.
If not, add the given TXT record to your domain's DNS records and try verifying again.
Keep in mind that it may take up to 10 minutes for new TXT DNS records to propagate.

Skip this verification when using Hostinger's free subdomains (*.hostingersite.com).

actions.description:

endpoint) this endpoint returns 409 with a `Retry-After` header: wait that many

actions.name: hosting_list_website_files_and_directories
actions.description:
List website files and directories. List files and directories under a website's document root.

Use `directory` to browse a subdirectory relative to the document root. Symlinked entries
are listed but never traversed into or resolved.

actions.description:
Get website file content. Get a single file's content, relative to a website's document root.

actions.name: hosting_get_git_auto_deployment_settings
actions.description:
Get Git auto-deployment settings. Returns the Git auto-deployment settings of the website: which repository and branch deploy
into which directory, and whether pushes trigger a deployment. `is_enabled` false keeps the
repository link but ignores pushes.

When the website has no auto-deployment configured every field is null. Save settings with
`Update Git auto-deployment settings`.

actions.name: hosting_update_git_auto_deployment_settings
actions.description:
Update Git auto-deployment settings. Creates or replaces the Git auto-deployment settings of the website: repository, branch, the
directory under the document root to deploy into, and `is_enabled`. Send the full set;
`is_enabled` defaults to true and `directory` to the document root. `installation_uuid` must

actions.description:
Delete Git auto-deployment settings. Removes the Git auto-deployment settings of the website. Files already deployed stay on the
website; pushes stop deploying until settings are saved again. Succeeds also when nothing is
configured.

actions.name: hosting_list_git_installations
actions.description:
List Git installations. Lists the Git provider accounts the customer has connected. Only installations with status
`active` are returned unless the `status` filter says otherwise.

An empty list means the customer has no active installation. Check `status=suspended` and
`status=pending` as well. If there is none at all, a Git provider (GitHub or GitLab) has to be

Import Git Repository); this endpoint then lists the new installation.

actions.name: hosting_list_git_installation_repositories
actions.description:
List Git installation repositories. Lists the repositories the Git installation can access, read live from the provider. Works
for github and gitlab installations. Use an active installation: a suspended or pending one
is still queried and the call fails with whatever the provider answers. The list is cut at
the first 500 repositories in the order the provider returns them; when the account has
more, name the repository directly instead of searching this list.

`Start Node.js build` or into `Update Git auto-deployment settings`. Returns 404 when the
installation does not belong to the customer. Limi...

reset to its last commit and pulled: changes made on the server to files the repository tracks are

List website Git repositories. Lists the Git repositories linked to directories of the website, with
`Deploy website Git repository` or in the Git section of hPanel: clone URL, branch and directory of

actions.description:

on the Git host. `public_key` is null when the account has no key yet.

actions.name: hosting_generate_git_ssh_key
actions.description:
Generate Git SSH key. Creates the SSH key pair of the hosting account and returns the public key. When the account already
has a key, returns that key unchanged. One key serves every website of the account; add the public
key to a private repository as a deploy key before deploying it.

actions.description:

actions.description:
Get Node.js runtime logs. Returns the Node.js application's runtime console log entries, oldest first, each with
timestamp, level and message. On the first call send `period` (`1h`, `1d`, `1w` or `1m`)
and optionally `levels` and `limit` (1-5000, default 1000); when more entries match than
`limit`, the newest are kept.

To poll for new entries send `total_lines + 1` from the previous response as `from_line`
and omit `period`; `period` and `from_line` cannot be combined. Lines that are not JSON
with a timestamp, level and message are skipped, so `logs` may hold fewer than `limit`
entries while `total_lines` counts every raw line. Entries with a timestamp before
`last_deployed_at` belong to...

period.description: Time window for the first fetch. Required when `from_line` is not sent.

from_line.description:
1-based line of the log file to start from. For polling send `total_lines + 1` from the
previous response. Cannot be combined with `period`.

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return. When more entries match, the newest are kept.

levels.description:
Return only entries with these log levels, sent as a comma-separated list, e.g. ERROR,WARN.
Matching runs on the raw log line, so entries written with numeric levels (for example by
pino) are excluded while this filter is set.

actions.name: hosting_clear_nodejs_runtime_logs
actions.description:
Clear Node.js runtime logs. Empties the Node.js application's runtime log file. This cannot be undone, so confirm with
the user before calling it. Returns success even when no log file exists yet.

Use it before reproducing a problem so the next `Get Node.js runtime logs` call returns
only fresh entries; start that call with `period` again instead of reusing a `from_line`
from before the clear.

actions.name: hosting_restart_nodejs_application
actions.description:
Restart Node.js application. Restarts the Node.js server process for the website. Does not rebuild or redeploy the
application. Use it to apply environment or configuration changes, or to recover a hung
application.

Only applicable to server-side applications (Express, Next.js, NestJS, etc.). Static
front-end apps (React, Vue, Vite) have no persistent server process, so restarting them
has no effect. Returns success even when the website has no server process to restart.

actions.name: hosting_list_nodejs_vulnerabilities
actions.description:
List Node.js vulnerabilities. Lists known npm package vulnerabilities detected on a Node.js website, enriched with
advisory metadata (severity, CVSS score, CVE, advisory URL). Results are sorted from
the most severe to the least severe, then by publish date (newest first). Use the
`severities` query parameter to filter.

Vulnerabilities with `is_patchable` set to `true` can be auto-fixed via the
`Patch Node.js Vulnerabilities` endpoint, which opens a GitHub pull request with
updated package versions. Auto-fix is only available for websites deployed from a
connected GitHub repository. Vulnerabilities with `is_patching_in_progress` set to
`true` are already included in an open patch pull re...

actions.name: hosting_patch_nodejs_vulnerabilities
actions.description:
Patch Node.js vulnerabilities. Patches the selected Node.js vulnerabilities by updating the affected package versions
in `package.json` and opening a GitHub pull request in the connected repository. The
customer reviews and merges the pull request; merging triggers the automatic deployment.

Auto-fix is only available for websites deployed from a connected GitHub repository.
Websites deployed from an archive have no auto-fix path and return a 404. The Hostinger
GitHub App needs write access to the repository; without it the request fails with a
403 explaining the missing permission.

Only vulnerabilities with `is_patchable` set to `true` can be patched. Non-patchable
IDs in the selection ...

vulnerability_ids.description: List of vulnerability IDs to patch, as returned by the list vulnerabilities endpoint.

actions.name: hosting_list_website_setups
actions.description:
List website setups. Returns the website setups started in the last 24 hours for the hosting accounts
accessible to the authenticated client, newest first. Narrow the list with the
`order_id`, `subscription_id` or `domain` filters.

Meant for polling right after creating a website or starting a website setup: the
website shows up in the websites list before its server-side setup has finished, and
while the setup is `running` endpoints that operate on that website may respond with
`404` or `409`. Poll this endpoint with the `domain` filter every 10 to 15 seconds and
wait for `status: completed` before uploading files, deploying or creating databases.
`failed` means the setup stopped before...

subscription_id.description: Filter by hosting order subscription ID

actions.name: hosting_start_website_setup
actions.description:
Start website setup. Starts a website setup on a Web or Cloud hosting order and returns the created setup
right away; the website itself is provisioned asynchronously. Poll the list website
setups endpoint (`hosting_websites_list-setups`) with the `domain` filter every 10 to 15
seconds and wait for `status: completed` before uploading files, deploying or creating
databases.

Omit `type` for an empty website. `type: wordpress` installs WordPress in the website
root with the admin user, email and password from `wordpress`, the domain as the site
title, and `en_US` when `wordpress.language` is omitted. The headless types
(`headless_empty`, `headless_wordpress`, `headless_ecommerce`, `headles...

order_id.description: Hosting order ID. List orders to find available IDs.

type.description: Website type. Omit or `null` for an empty website. `wordpress` installs WordPress in the website root and requires `wordpress`. The headless types (`headless_empty`, `headless_wordpress`, `headless_ecommerce`, `headless_pocketbase`) create a headless website; `headless_wordpress` additionally installs WordPress into the `cms` directory with generated credentials. `headless_empty` installs nothing, so WordPress can be added later through `POST /api/hosting/v1/accounts/{username}/wordpress/installations` (`wordpress_installations_install`) with `type: headless`.

domain.description: Customer-owned domain, or a free subdomain you generated through `POST /api/hosting/v1/domains/free-subdomains` (`hosting_domains_generate-free-subdomain`) in the last 24 hours. Cannot start with "www." and can have at most one subdomain level, e.g. `blog.example.com`. Omit or `null` to set the website up on a generated temporary free subdomain.

datacenter_code.description: Datacenter for the hosting account when the order does not have one yet. Omit to use the order's default datacenter. Ignored when the order already has a hosting account. List available datacenters to find valid codes.

wordpress.description: WordPress install settings. Required when `type` is `wordpress`, not allowed otherwise. The site title is the domain.

language.description: WordPress locale, for example `en_US` or `lt_LT`. Defaults to `en_US` when omitted.

is_ai_builder.description: When `true`, installs the Hostinger AI theme (`hostinger-ai-theme`). Defaults to `false` when omitted.

user.description: WordPress admin username (letters, numbers, and underscore)

password.description: WordPress admin password (8-50 characters, mixed case, a digit, and not compromised)

actions.name: hosting_list_orders
actions.description:
List orders. Retrieve a paginated list of orders accessible to the authenticated client.

Only Web and Cloud hosting orders are listed. Agency Plan orders are listed by
`GET /api/agency-hosting/v1/orders`.

This endpoint returns orders of your hosting accounts as well as orders
of other client hosting accounts that have shared access with you.

Use the available query parameters to filter results by order statuses
or specific order IDs for more targeted results.

actions.name: hosting_reset_php_extensions
actions.description:
Reset PHP extensions. Resets all PHP extensions of the website to their default state.

Use it to recover from extension conflicts or restore the original configuration.

actions.name: hosting_get_php_details
actions.description:
Get PHP details. Returns the full PHP configuration for the website: current version, available versions
(supported and unsupported), enabled/disabled extensions, options with their current value,
default, type and the plan limit (`max`), and conflicting extension groups.

Use it to check the current PHP setup before updating the version, extensions or options.

actions.name: hosting_get_php_info
actions.description:
Get PHP info. Returns the full phpinfo page (HTML) for the website.

Use it to debug PHP issues or inspect the complete PHP environment of the website.

actions.name: hosting_update_php_extensions
actions.description:
Update PHP extensions. Enables or disables PHP extensions (modules) for the website.

Use the Get PHP details endpoint to check the current extension states before changing them.

actions.name: hosting_update_php_options
actions.description:
Update PHP options. Updates PHP options for the website (e.g. `memory_limit`, `max_execution_time`, `upload_max_filesize`).
Only provide the options you want to change, inside the `options` object.

Values above the account plan limit are silently capped to that limit, so the request can succeed
with a smaller applied value. Call the Get PHP details endpoint afterwards to read the applied value.

options.description: Map of PHP options to update, keyed by option name. Only include options you want to change.

actions.name: hosting_update_php_version
actions.description:
Update PHP version. Changes the PHP version of the website.

Use the Get PHP details endpoint to see the versions available for the website.

version.description: PHP version to switch the website to.

actions.name: hosting_list_website_redirects
actions.description: List website redirects. Returns a paginated list of redirects configured for the selected website.

actions.name: hosting_create_website_redirect
actions.description: Create website redirect. Creates a redirect from a URL on the selected website to another URL or IP address.

from.description: Source URL on the selected website

actions.name: hosting_delete_website_redirect
actions.description:
Delete website redirect. Permanently deletes the redirect identified by its source URL.

Pass the `from` value exactly as returned by the list redirects endpoint.
