Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

actions.name: hosting_show_litespeed_cache_status
actions.description:
Show LiteSpeed Cache status. Show the LiteSpeed Cache status for the specified WordPress installation.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

actions.name: hosting_create_login_links
actions.description:
Create login links. Create temporary auto-login links for the specified WordPress installation.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

actions.name: hosting_show_maintenance_status
actions.description:
Show maintenance status. Show the maintenance mode status for the specified WordPress installation.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

actions.name: hosting_toggle_maintenance_mode
actions.description:
Toggle maintenance mode. Enable or disable maintenance mode for the specified WordPress installation,
based on the `enabled` flag.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

enabled.description: Enable (true) or disable (false) maintenance mode for the WordPress installation.

actions.name: hosting_show_memcached_object_cache_status
actions.description:
Show Memcached object cache status. Show the Memcached object cache status for the specified WordPress
installation.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

actions.name: hosting_toggle_memcached_object_cache
actions.description:
Toggle Memcached object cache. Activate or deactivate the Memcached object cache for the specified WordPress
installation, based on the `enabled` flag.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

enabled.description: Activate (true) or deactivate (false) the Memcached object cache for the WordPress installation.

actions.name: hosting_activate_wordpress_plugin
actions.description:
Activate WordPress plugin. Activate an installed plugin on a WordPress installation.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

This operation is asynchronous: a successful response only means the activation
job has been queued.

plugin.description: Slug of the installed plugin to activate.

actions.name: hosting_deactivate_wordpress_plugin
actions.description:
Deactivate WordPress plugin. Deactivate an installed plugin on a WordPress installation.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

This operation is asynchronous: a successful response only means the
deactivation job has been queued.

plugin.description: Slug of the installed plugin to deactivate.

actions.name: hosting_deploy_wordpress_plugin
actions.description:
Deploy WordPress plugin. Deploy a WordPress plugin from an already uploaded directory.

This endpoint allows you to deploy a WordPress plugin that has been uploaded to the website's directory.
The plugin will be activated and made available in the WordPress admin panel.

plugin_path.description: Relative path to the plugin directory from wp-content/plugins

actions.name: hosting_install_wordpress_plugins
actions.description:
Install WordPress plugins. Install one or more plugins on an existing WordPress installation.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id`
field). Use GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/plugins to discover the plugin
slugs available for installation.

This operation is asynchronous: a successful response only means the install
job has been queued, not that the plugins are ready.

plugins.description: Plugin slugs to install. Use GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/plugins to discover available slugs.

actions.name: hosting_list_available_wordpress_plugins
actions.description:
List available WordPress plugins. List plugins recommended for installation on a WordPress installation that are
not yet installed.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

actions.name: hosting_list_installed_wordpress_plugins
actions.description:
List installed WordPress plugins. List plugins installed on a WordPress installation, including their status,
available updates and known vulnerabilities.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

actions.name: hosting_search_wordpress_plugins
actions.description:
Search WordPress plugins. Search the WordPress.org plugin directory for plugins available to install.

Use the returned `slug` values with
POST /api/hosting/v1/accounts/{username}/wordpress/{software}/plugins/install.

search.description: Search term to match against plugin names. Minimum 3 characters.

actions.name: hosting_list_suggested_wordpress_plugins
actions.description:
List suggested WordPress plugins. List curated plugin suggestions grouped by website type.

Use the returned `slug` values with
POST /api/hosting/v1/accounts/{username}/wordpress/{software}/plugins/install.

order_id.description: Optionally scope suggestions to a specific order.

actions.name: hosting_check_if_woocommerce_is_installed
actions.description:
Check if WooCommerce is installed. Check whether WooCommerce is installed on any WordPress installation of a
domain. Optionally filter by domain to scope the check.

domain.description: Filter by domain name (case-insensitive substring match)

actions.name: hosting_uninstall_wordpress_plugins
actions.description:
Uninstall WordPress plugins. Uninstall one or more plugins from a WordPress installation.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

This operation is asynchronous: a successful response only means the uninstall
job has been queued.

plugins.description: Slugs of the installed plugins to uninstall.

actions.name: hosting_update_hostinger_wordpress_plugin
actions.description:
Update Hostinger WordPress plugin. Update a Hostinger plugin to its latest version on a WordPress installation.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

This operation is asynchronous: a successful response only means the update job
has been queued.

slug.description: Slug of the Hostinger plugin to update to its latest version.

actions.name: hosting_update_wordpress_plugins
actions.description:
Update WordPress plugins. Update one or more installed plugins to their latest version on a WordPress
installation.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

This operation is asynchronous: a successful response only means the update job
has been queued.

plugins.description: Slugs of the installed plugins to update to their latest version.

actions.name: hosting_activate_wordpress_theme
actions.description:
Activate WordPress theme. Activate an installed theme on a WordPress installation.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

This operation is asynchronous: a successful response only means the activation
job has been queued.

theme.description: Slug of the installed theme to activate.

actions.name: hosting_deploy_wordpress_theme
actions.description:
Deploy WordPress theme. Deploy a WordPress theme from an already uploaded directory.

This endpoint allows you to deploy a WordPress theme that has been uploaded to the website's directory.
The theme can be optionally activated after deployment.

theme_path.description: Relative path to the theme directory from wp-content/themes

is_activated.description: Whether to activate the theme after deployment

actions.name: hosting_install_wordpress_theme
actions.description:
Install WordPress theme. Install a theme on an existing WordPress installation.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id`
field).

When the theme is one of the Hostinger themes (hostinger-blog,
hostinger-affiliate-theme, hostinger-ai-theme), the optional `palette`,
`layout`, and `font` fields are forwarded to the custom installer (defaults:
palette1, layout1, default). For any other theme they are ignored.

This operation is asynchronous: a successful response only means the install
job has been queued, not that the theme is ready.

theme.description: Slug of the theme to install. Hostinger theme slugs (hostinger-blog, hostinger-affiliate-theme, hostinger-ai-theme) trigger the custom installer and forward the optional palette/layout/font fields; any other WordPress theme slug uses the standard installer and ignores those fields.

palette.description: Palette identifier. Only applied when the theme is a Hostinger theme; the default is used when omitted.

layout.description: Layout identifier. Only applied when the theme is a Hostinger theme; the default is used when omitted.

font.description: Font identifier. Only applied when the theme is a Hostinger theme; the default is used when omitted.

actions.name: hosting_list_installed_wordpress_themes
actions.description:
List installed WordPress themes. List themes installed on a WordPress installation, including their status,
available updates and known vulnerabilities.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

actions.name: hosting_list_wordpress_themes
actions.description:
List WordPress themes available to install.

Use the returned `slug` values with
POST /api/hosting/v1/accounts/{username}/wordpress/{software}/themes/install.

order_id.description: Optionally scope themes to a specific order.

search.description: Search term to match against theme names.

actions.name: hosting_uninstall_wordpress_themes
actions.description:
Uninstall WordPress themes. Uninstall one or more themes from a WordPress installation.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

This operation is asynchronous: a successful response only means the uninstall
job has been queued.

themes.description: Slugs of the installed themes to uninstall.

actions.name: hosting_update_wordpress_themes
actions.description:
Update WordPress themes. Update one or more installed themes to their latest version on a WordPress
installation.

Provide the WordPress installation (software) identifier in the path. It can
be obtained from GET /api/hosting/v1/wordpress/installations (the `id` field).

This operation is asynchronous: a successful response only means the update job
has been queued.

themes.description: Slugs of the installed themes to update to their latest version.
